phone.changelog:
• Overnight Sleep Architecture & Stages: Automatic reception and visualization of Deep, Light, REM, and Awake stages synced from watch
• Daily Readiness & Recovery Score: Dynamic 0–100 score combining sleep duration, stage efficiency, and resting HR
• Blood Oxygen (SpO2) Trends: 24-hour saturation graphs and low-oxygen alerts
• Comprehensive Health Ecosystem: Seamless synchronization for workouts, hydration, and stand metrics

watch.changelog:
• Automatic Sleep Tracking: Motion actigraphy and resting HR stage detection (Deep, Light, REM, Awake) with sleep score
• Blood Oxygen (SpO2) Spot-Check: 15-second guided optical pulse measurement screen with pulsating ring
• Stress & HRV Monitoring: Real-time physiological stress gauge with 1-Minute Box Breathing relax mode and haptic rhythm
• Tactical Aerospace Compass: Low-pass filtered rotating rose with degree readout, cardinal indicators, GPS elevation, and True North haptic tick
• Sedentary Stand Reminders & Hydration: Hourly inactivity vibration alerts ('Time to Stand!') and 1-tap water logging
